title: Saudi employee arrested for allegedly bugging OpenAI office in San Francisco
hook_text: OpenAI employee arrested for bugging office
script:
Federal agents arrested OpenAI software engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan on October ninth.
He allegedly planted a hidden recording device inside the OpenAI San Francisco headquarters.
OpenAI security teams discovered the device and reported it directly to the FBI.
The United States Department of Justice charged Alfozan with intercepting oral communications.
Prosecutors allege he intended to record proprietary meetings about future AI model development.
He faces up to five years in federal prison if convicted.
Would you trust an office environment with this level of internal security risk?
